note: NECO CRS round 2 (Round 18 lift): named-episode details new to every bank - Sarah's laugh, Esau's pottage, Bethel and Peniel, the silver cup in Benjamin's sack, basket and burning bush, firstborn plague, manna, Aaron and Hur, Jericho's seven marches, Achan at Ai, Samson and Delilah, Deborah and Barak, Nathan's ewe-lamb parable, Absalom, Rehoboam's split, Naboth's vineyard, Isaiah's coal, dry bones, Hosea's wife, whirlwind, wise men's gifts, temple at twelve, feeding 5000, widow of Nain, Barabbas, the penitent thief, Great Commission, Ananias and Sapphira, the seven, Rhoda, Priscilla and Aquila - plus themes (Hebrews faith, seventy times seven, Golden Rule, walking by faith, care for widows). Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the large JAMB CRS banks.
